title: Engineering proposal: planning-contracts
expected_outcome: Forge can represent and validate planned increments.

included_work: Models, schemas, validation, and local persistence only.
excluded_work: Repository execution, tool invocation, commits, and approval are excluded.

rationale.why_this_increment_exists: Planning must remain declarative before any execution layer exists.
rationale.roadmap_relationship: Advances engineering goal planning-foundation through plan planning-foundation-plan.
rationale.evidence_relationship: Preserves the planning and supplied knowledge evidence references.

assumptions: Approval and execution remain future capabilities.

technical_risk.rationale: Derived from the planned increment risk classification.

governance_risk.rationale: The artifact remains governed intention and does not approve or execute work.

scope_risk.rationale: Scope is bounded to the declared increment and its affected capabilities.
